about: KOF engine (KOF96 / 98 / 99 family) fighter-object fields and flag bits, as read from the KOF98 P ROM (addresses are KOF98's; KOF96 / KOF99 use the same object layout, their routines sit elsewhere: tools/kof96/handlers98.py ROUTINES96 / ROUTINES99). Used by tools/brawler/convsheet.py: every bit write a special's handler makes that the decoder (handlers98) drops is looked up here; a bit without an entry, or with effect 'unknown', is listed as UNEXPLAINED on the move's conversion sheet. effect: 'gameplay' (changes what the move does in KOF), 'none' (no gameplay effect in the brawler: guard / CPU AI cues, presentation, bookkeeping), 'unknown'. brawler: how the brawler covers it. evidence: the ROM code that reads / writes the bit (KOF98). Read 2026-10-06 (TODO #142).

fields.+$00: resume address of the object's coroutine (move.l #R, (a4))
fields.+$18: x (word: px, the low word fraction)
fields.+$31: facing (bit 0 set = facing right; the decoder assumes right, a left facing negates vx / dx)
fields.+$7C: the current step's flags, high byte (animate $5C4A: step bytes 4-5 -> +$7C / +$7D)
fields.+$7D: the current step's flags, low byte
fields.+$C2: handler scratch (Rising Tackle: the rise counter, subq at $42F48; Power Geyser: pointer into its state / pillar table)
fields.+$C6: handler scratch (Power Geyser: pointer into its pillar offset table)
fields.+$D1: signal bits between a fighter and its objects
fields.+$D2: handler scratch word 0 (a state list entry, or a count: Power Geyser's +$D2 = pillars)
fields.+$D4: handler scratch word 1 (a state list entry, or a count: Power Geyser's +$D2 = pillars)
fields.+$D6: handler scratch word 2 (a state list entry, or a count: Power Geyser's +$D2 = pillars)
fields.+$D8: handler scratch word 3 (a state list entry, or a count: Power Geyser's +$D2 = pillars)
fields.+$EF: damage table index of the move's hits (read by the stats routines $18C1C / $18C84)
fields.+$108: damage / attack stats byte read with +$EF (stats routines)
fields.+$170: CPU control (bit 7: CPU player; the decoder takes a human)
fields.+$19C: catch routine (run after a catch box's hit-stop)
fields.+$1A4: the special's button (bit 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D: copied from the input record a3 +$7D at the handler's start)
fields.+$1D6: EX flag (non-zero: the fighter is the EX version)

+$7C.0.name: attack box live (step flag $0100)
+$7C.0.meaning: The step's first attack box can hit. Collision $3AD0 tests +$7C bits 0-3 (box slots), clears the slot's bit on a hit ($3B1C).

+$7C.5.name: follow-up window (step flag $2000)
+$7C.5.meaning: A follow-up input window is open on this step.

+$7C.6.name: chained hit (step flag $4000)
+$7C.6.meaning: A hit on this step sets the attacker's +$E2 bit 7 (no further hits in the chain).

+$7C.7.name: animation ended
+$7C.7.meaning: Set by animate past the last step ($5CB8).

+$7D.7.name: event step (step flag $0080)
+$7D.7.brawler: P_EVCLR / PC_EVENT (andi on +$7D = the event consumed)
+$7D.7.meaning: The step is the move's event; the handler consumes it with andi.

+$D1.6.name: object signal 6
+$D1.6.meaning: An object signals its owner (K''s shot hit / gone).

+$D1.7.name: effects end (fxoff) / object signal
+$D1.7.meaning: Owner side: its attached effects end (they test the owner's bit: Burn Knuckle's flame $42A86); object side: a signal to the owner.

+$E0.0.name: attacking (opponent's proximity guard)
+$E0.0.brawler: no guard in the brawler (ruleset 'guard / chip')
+$E0.0.meaning: The fighter is attacking: the opponent walking back within 224 px turns it into a guard (state 26). Set on the owner while its effect lives ($24A86 'ownerflag'), cleared by $24A68.

+$E1.2.name: guard trigger at any distance
+$E1.2.meaning: With +$E0 bit 0: the opponent's walk-back guards whatever the distance (an effect / projectile out).

+$E1.5.name: projectile in flight
+$E1.5.brawler: one projectile at a time per thrower (ruleset 'projectiles')

+$E1.6.name: catch spent
+$E1.6.brawler: decode-time: the catch routine (P_ONHIT) is exported only while the bit is clear
+$E1.6.meaning: Set once the catch routine ran ($1B3DA, $1D6AC, $1DAA6); the catch test $1B9F6 / $1BA32 runs +$19C only while it is clear. $250C6 clears it (with +$E6 bit 0 and the opponent's +$E2 bit 2 / +$E4 bit 2 / +$E5 bit 1).

+$E2.1.name: super flash ends
+$E2.1.brawler: the super flash is not in the brawler (presentation, TODO #139)
+$E2.1.meaning: The super-flash routines ($19A88 / $19AB4 / $19AE0 / $19B06, 'superflash') spawn the flash object $19898 and clear the owner's bit; the flash frees itself when its owner sets it ($198BE / $19900). A desperation move sets it when its flash should end (Ryo's Ryuuko Ranbu $48382).

+$E2.2.name: was hit: attached effects end
+$E2.2.brawler: fighter.c special_end on a hit out of a special (all its objects go, travelling ones too)
+$E2.2.meaning: Set when the fighter takes a hit ($1B48A in the hit routine, $1E818 the cinematic hit); every attached effect tests its owner's bit and frees itself (Burn Knuckle's flame $42A7E, 170 sites). A handler clears it before spawning its effect so an old hit does not end the new one.

+$E2.7.name: attack boxes off (chain hit landed)
+$E2.7.brawler: no flag: the brawler opens one hit per active step run (bstep_t flags 16 chains); a state with more openings after the connect would hit again
+$E2.7.meaning: While set, the yield routine clears +$7C bit 0 every frame after animate ($17004, $1718E): no attack box is live. Collision sets it when a $4000 step hits ($3B2A); handlers set it on their hit (Burn Knuckle $42A00: one hit) and clear it on landing / at the next part ($42A2A, 106 andi sites).

+$E3.2.name: guard trigger while airborne
+$E3.2.meaning: Read by the opponent's guard test for a jumping fighter ($1490E); set with +$E0 bit 0 by $24A86.

+$E4.0.name: SDM / object stats from the owner
+$E4.0.brawler: damage scale is the brawler's (ruleset 'damage scale')
+$E4.0.meaning: Desperation-move power level bit (dmcheck); on an object, $2505A then runs $18C84 (its damage stats from +$EF and the owner).

+$E4.4.name: caught victim held
+$E4.4.meaning: The caught victim stays a standing reel while held.

kof98:$24AA0.name: ownerflag (set)
kof98:$24AA0.brawler: no guard: the opponent's proximity guard cue while the effect lives

kof98:$250C6.name: flags
kof98:$250C6.brawler: catch re-armed (decode-time, see +$E1.6); the opponent's bits: unknown beyond +$E2.2

kof98:$2505A.name: object stats
kof98:$2505A.meaning: if +$E4 bit 0: jsr $18C84 (the object's damage stats from +$EF and its owner)

kof96:$1A8E6.name: ownerflag (set)
kof96:$1A8E6.brawler: no guard: the opponent's proximity guard cue while the effect lives
